item.text: {"summary":"The regression is localized to absl/time/format.cc: both FormatTime(format, time, tz) and ParseTime(format, input, tz, ...) receive a timezone but pass UTCTimeZone() to CCTZ. Formatting therefore renders every finite time as UTC; parsing input without an explicit offset interprets it as UTC. The supplied implementation, API contract, and failure evidence are sufficient to identify the repair site and account for all reported failures, including extreme-time formatting.","hypotheses":["FormatTime ignores its tz argument when calling cctz::detail::format, causing named-zone, DST, and offset formatting failures, including ConversionSaturation.","ParseTime ignores its tz argument when calling cctz::detail::parse, so local civil fields without an explicit offset are interpreted as UTC; explicit-offset parsing should retain its documented behavior."],"queries":[],"reads":[],"ready":true}
